'''Tordich Envlo''' was a [[near-human]] [[Gender|male]] [[Engineer|mechanic]] who served on board an independent [[freighter]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. In [[10 BBY]], Envlo's crew were doing work on the ice-covered [[planet]] [[Vandor]],<ref name="SoloOG" /> where he was present in the [[Cantina|saloon]] known as [[the Lodge]] when the [[human]] outlaws [[Han Solo]] and [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] first met over a [[Gambling|game]] of [[sabacc]].<ref name="Solo">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>

Envlo hoped that his [[captain]] would soon find work on a warmer planet, and in order to cope with the extremely cold temperatures on Vandor, Envlo spent a large sum of [[Currency|money]] on a dense [[kod'yok]] [[Hair|fur]] [[jacket]] that engulfed his entire body. He also wore an emergency [[Environment suit|vac-suit]] that covered his face and provided some insulation as well as a pair of hermetically sealed [[reactor]] [[glove]]s.<ref name="SoloOG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tordich Envlo first appeared in the [[2018]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology]] film, ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''<ref name="Solo" /> and was first identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="SoloOG" />
